$comment: Words that describe something Ward Flow no longer uses. scripts/doc-facts.mjs warns on every current mention in maintained docs and fails a pull request that adds a new one. Add a term when a decision retires something; remove it once nothing should ever warn again. A line that matches allowWhen (for example one saying the thing is retired) is current and never flagged. Dated records, archives and the files listed in historicalFiles are history and are never scanned. Inside a maintained doc, keep a deliberate historical mention by wrapping it in the docs-script-refs:historical-start and docs-script-refs:historical-end markers.

terms.why: D-66 removes the second approval requirement for coordinator and access-admin role grants in the synthetic prototype.
terms.instead: Granted roles work immediately. Keep grant authority, scope, expiry, revocation and audit requirements.

terms.why: Supabase is Ward Flow's database and sign-in service. Azure (Functions, Blob Storage, PostgreSQL) and Microsoft Entra ID are retired.
terms.instead: Name Supabase, or quote the current value with <!-- fact:database-provider --> from docs/FACTS.md. Delete the mention, or fence it as history.

terms.pattern: \b(?:no_bed|sex_mix|out_of_catchment)\b|["'`](?:No bed(?: available)?|Sex mix|Out of catchment(?: area)?|Gender mix constraint)["'`]
terms.why: D-78 merges the ward and coordinator decline lists into one list in the coordinator's wording. The ward values No bed, Sex mix and Out of catchment are retired and convert on load.
terms.instead: Say No suitable bed (no_suitable_bed), Sex designation unavailable (sex_designation_unavailable) or Belongs to another service (belongs_to_another_service).
